== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Seven-Year [[Festival]] is a recurring event held every seven years by the various clans residing in [[Sacred Valley]]. It serves as a significant opportunity for different clans to demonstrate their strength and compete against one another. During the festival, rival groups often attempt to gain advantages through rigged trade deals or questionable bets. The hosting duties rotate among the clans; for instance, while the [[Wei clan]] hosted a previous iteration, the [[Kazan clan]] was expected to host the subsequent one, though hosting duties were later shifted to honor a new [[Grand Elder]] within the [[Wei clan]]. Preparation for the event is extensive, involving outside craftsmen who spend months improving the host clan's infrastructure by building booths, repairing roads, and decorating buildings to ensure a well-presented environment for the large influx of guests from across the valley. The festival includes various competitions, such as tournaments where top performers can earn unique treasures like the [[Broken Crown]].}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The Seven-Year [[Festival]] serves as a grand occasion for the clans of [[Sacred Valley]] to compete against one another and demonstrate their collective power. Hosted by the [[Wei clan]] this year, the event features an arena where [[Kelsa]] fights to represent her family. Once guests have settled into the festivities, a series of important events take place throughout the celebration.}}
